objective: Preregister three signal-card specifications for the signed high-frequency news-return feature (Jiang-Li-Wang) -- NHF01 rank on the raw daily news_return, NHF02 rank on a trailing 5-session sum, NHF03 event on large positive reactions -- against the admission rule already fixed in reports/research/signal-cards/library-v1-manifest.json, before the feature is built at scale and before any signal-card result exists. No strategy backtest is run in this iteration.

feature_coverage: news archive coverage as of this build; SIP minute bars 2023+
signal_card_recent_window: signal_card.py's own RECENT_START convention, reused unchanged

rank_mode_shuffle.description: signal_card.py's own within-day shuffle placebo (10 seeds), 252-session-stale placebo, and overlap with the four standard controls (momentum_12_1, reversal_5d, size, volatility) -- reused unchanged, not reinvented for this direction.

event_mode_redated.description: signal_card.py's own redated-event placebo (20 seeds, each event moved to a random session of the same stock within +/-126 sessions) -- reused unchanged.

adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 3 candidates, no ranking between them; the shared, unmodified library-wide admission rule is the only bar
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: keep refuted (dir:high_freq_news_return_underreaction_drift stays closed pending new disclosed data or a materially different construction)
